title_o: Diet Pill and Laxative Use for Weight Control and Subsequent Incident Eating Disorder in US Young Women: 2001–2016

replications.quote: participants using diet pills (risk ratio [RR] = 3.58, 95% confidence interval [CI]: 1.96–6.54) and laxatives (RR = 2.77, 95% CI: 1.01–7.64) had greater risk
